description:
Operating Area: India

Ferritti a 55 footer luxurious yacht one of its kind on the Mumbai harbour with spacious deck views of the entire ocean from a distance which enables us to enjoy its scenic beauty.
It has 3 rooms and 3 washrooms and a capacity of 15 guests on board.
Ferritti is of exceptional design and quality, packed with features, unprecedented safe and easy handling and real open sea comfort.
The bedrooms are fully equipped with teak wood furnished bathrooms, television screen and a DVD player.
The yacht has different levels of decks, the upper deck can accommodate 10 people at a time, the rear deck about 8 people, the front deck is the perfect place to have a photo-shoot or selfie for the entire group which also has a sunbathing mat, which also creates comfort which your enjoying your entire cruising.
The kitchen is fully furnished with crockery, cutlery and glasses and heating facility with a dining table so the entire buffet can be served well, which is attached to the saloon room.
The boat has speakers where one can use an iPod or attach their phones to play music
The yacht is chartered for special celebrations of birthday, anniversary, and romantic dinner on the yachts for couples at a great deal.
Having a good capacity for a big group, we have lots of corporate get together and party on the yachts.
Ferritti is a beauty of its own which speaks for elegance, luxury, space and seamless performance on the Mumbai harbour
The yacht is very popular for photo shoots, for pre wedding, short add films, movies, day trips or even destination trips to Mandwa (Alibaug)
The above price includes a transfer boat ride to the yacht, once you reach the yacht there will be 120 mins ( 2 hours) of charter time ( 1 hour cruising and 1 hour anchor) and then again, one is sent back on the same transfer boat to the shore.
3rd hour and 4th hour requirement can be discussed if required with the customer care before booking.
